data_sources.gpu_specs: /app/gpu_specs.db — SQLite database, table 'gpu_specs' with columns (gpu_name TEXT, spec_key TEXT, spec_value TEXT)
data_sources.team_analysis: /app/team_analysis.json — The team's (potentially flawed) analysis to audit

register_model.description: Estimated registers per thread for the warptiling kernel. WMITER is derived as (WM * WN) / (WARPSIZE * TM * TN * WNITER) where WARPSIZE=32.
register_model.formula: WMITER * TM * WNITER * TN + WMITER * TM + WNITER * TN + 20
register_model.note: If the formula yields more than 255, cap at 255 (excess spills to local memory).

<config_name>.actually_valid: boolean: true if the config satisfies all kernel constraints
<config_name>.validity_error: boolean: true if team's claimed_valid differs from actually_valid
<config_name>.correct_occupancy: object {GPU_NAME: float} or null if config is actually invalid
<config_name>.correct_bottleneck: object {GPU_NAME: string} or null if config is actually invalid
<config_name>.occupancy_errors: sorted list of GPU names where team's claimed occupancy differs by more than 1e-4. Empty list if config is invalid.
<config_name>.bottleneck_errors: sorted list of GPU names where team's claimed bottleneck string differs. Empty list if config is invalid.

<GPU_NAME>.team_pick_valid: boolean: whether the team's chosen config is actually valid
<GPU_NAME>.team_pick_optimal: boolean: whether the team's pick achieves the maximum possible occupancy on this GPU among all valid configs from the full parameter space
<GPU_NAME>.actual_best_occupancy: float: the true maximum occupancy achievable on this GPU from full enumeration
<GPU_NAME>.actual_best_config: object with keys BM, BN, BK, WM, WN, WNITER, TM, TN, NUM_THREADS — the config achieving maximum occupancy (ties broken by lowest smem_bytes, then lowest NUM_THREADS, then lowest BM, then lowest BN)

schema.total_valid_configs: integer: total count of valid parameter tuples from the full Cartesian product of param_ranges.csv
schema.pareto_optimal_count: integer: count of Pareto-optimal configurations across all three GPU architectures from the full valid config set

portability_scores.<config_name>: float or null: for valid configs, min(occupancy across GPUs) / max(occupancy across GPUs) rounded to 6 decimal places. null for invalid configs.

schema.total_errors_found: integer: sum of all discrepancies: each validity_error counts 1, each GPU with wrong occupancy counts 1, each GPU with wrong bottleneck counts 1

output_spec.bottleneck_definition: The hardware resource producing the fewest concurrent blocks per SM. One of: 'blocks', 'regs', 'smem', 'warps'. If multiple resources tie at the minimum, report the alphabetically first.
output_spec.best_config_tiebreaking: Highest occupancy, then lowest smem_bytes, then lowest NUM_THREADS, then lowest BM, then lowest BN.
output_spec.pareto_definition: A configuration is Pareto-optimal if no other valid configuration achieves >= occupancy on every GPU and strictly > occupancy on at least one GPU.
